notes.title: Version 1.1.0
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37404039/c0ce1770417ac3518ddf1fec929b43b1bfd5783a.png
Version 1.1.0

A new version of Coof Attack has been released, featuring some mild changes to the general look of the game and improved performance for mid- and low range systems.

Changelog

Gameplay

 Pressing the yellow trashcan on the tutorial window now turns tutorials off. They can be enabled again in options.


Graphics

 Lighting has been improved; main menu is less spooky now.
 Post processing has been adjusted.
 All materials have been adjusted.
 UI elements have been replaced for a cleaner look.
 Hair and eyelashes now use a more appropriate shader.


Performance

 Overall performance has been improved.
 The game now needs less disk space.
 The presets in graphics options have been improved.
 Sounds and textures now use better compression.
 Certain building blocks have been optimised.
 Background buildings now use a more optimised version.
 Volumetric fog has been removed entirely.
 Timmy is now a cleaner and less resource-hogging 2D sprite.
 Support for additional networking channels has been added.


Bug fixes

 A bug that rendered one audio channel unusable has been fixed.
 Top panel of the custom level menu has been fixed.

notes.title: Version 1.0.3
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37404039/c0ce1770417ac3518ddf1fec929b43b1bfd5783a.png
Bug fixes and minor improvements

 A bug that prevented attire from unlocking has been fixed.
 On start-up, the game now checks if the current profile is missing unlocks it should have.
 Packmule and Recycled TP perks now function correctly when playing as client in multiplayer.
 A synching issue when joining an on-going match has been fixed.
 Two missing translations have been added for all localisations.
 A few localisation strings have been improved for Traditional Chinese.
 Minor GUI improvements have been made.
 A handful of minor bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: Version 1.0.2
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37404039/c0ce1770417ac3518ddf1fec929b43b1bfd5783a.png
Bug fixes and minor improvements

 Hints panel is now less obtrusive and relocated to the left of the screen.
 Hints now no longer interrupt the game while playing.
 Hints can now be skipped in the main menu by pressing the yellow trash icon.
 Options have been added to the in-game pause menu for audio settings and toggling hints on or off.
 A minor issue with music transitions has been fixed.

notes.title: Version 1.0.1
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37404039/c0ce1770417ac3518ddf1fec929b43b1bfd5783a.png
Bug fixes and minor improvements

 UI should now work as intended on all resolution options.
 A rare networking issue when loading into a new level has been fixed.
 Loading bar has been added to level transitions.
 Irrelevant sound effects have been disabled during level transition.
 Spectators now have a better camera offset.
 Annoying quirk when playing the Golden TP minigame fixed.
 Server browser now closes if a player joins you.
 Timmy now stops hiding behind UI elements.
 Some incorrect prop placements have been changed.
 Some textures now have better tiling.
